parts:
Hello,

I am trying to do imputation using STITCH. However, I am getting following error. 

The command used is :

STITCH(method = "diploid", outputdir = outputdir, chr = "chr1", posfile = posfile, bamlist = bamlist, K = K, tempdir = tempdir, environment = environment, nCores = nCores, nGen = nGen)

I request you to please help.
Thanking you with best regards

Sandip

messages.author: aa7b5c73c3a6760a
messages.subject: Re: NAs are not allowed in subscripted assignments\n
parts:
Hey,

Thanks for the email. Can you post the full message output? Does the error happen if you run it again with the same settings?

This error suggests something went wrong with the forward-backward C++ code that occurs just before it. I've seen that before with underflow but I didn't think that was a problem anymore. What's the nature of your sequencing data? How many samples, what is K, what kind of coverage, do any of the SNPs have high coverage (like with GBS where sometimes the coverage is really high)? Alternatively, since it's iteration 5, something may have gone wrong with shuffling underused haplotypes, so you can set shuffleHaplotypeIterations = NA and re-try?

Thanks,
Robbie
